answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 21754 Country: India Title: What if hair is not cut when child is born? I mean at the time of AQEEQAH.for both boy and girl child Question: What if hair is not cut when child is born? I mean at the time of AQEEQAH.for both boy and girl child Answer ID: 21754 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 629/629/M=1431) It is mustahab in aqiqah to shave hair of the baby for whom aqiqah is being performed and to give silver equal to its hair in charity. If someone does not do so i.e. does not shave the hair, then too aqiqah would be performed though it would not be better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
